# Thread & Vine Hall at Gibson Mill

> Event venue and music hall in a restored 1899 textile mill at 325 McGill Ave NW, Suite 148, Concord, North Carolina 28027. Five rooms for gatherings of 10 to 600: weddings, corporate events, celebrations, Christian concerts and worship nights, churches and nonprofits. A ministry of SOJO Church. Tagline: "Where good things are woven together."

## Key facts
- Capacity: 10 to 600 guests. The Loom (main hall) holds up to 600 standing; the No. 6 Lounge up to 50; the Spinning Room about 50 and the Thread Room up to 15 (both open January 2027); the Bobbin under 30. An outdoor deck comes with Loom events.
- 2027 room rates: the Loom $3,150 Saturday, $2,100 Friday, $1,260 Monday to Thursday. Hourly rooms from $35 to $105 per hour. Packages: the Workday from $840 per day, the Celebration from $245.
- Churches, ministries and partner nonprofits: 50% off room rental Monday to Thursday, 25% off Friday and Saturday. Tables, chairs and linens included for them; an add-on for public rentals.
- Every event: $250 cleaning fee. Sound and AV with our technician: $100 per hour.
- Booking: 50% non-refundable deposit holds the date; balance due 30 days before.
- Saturday events end by 11:00 PM; Friday events can run until 2:00 AM; Sunday mornings are reserved for SOJO Church.
- Outside caterers welcome. Alcohol only at approved private events, free to guests, served by a licensed bartender. Concerts are alcohol-free and feature Christian artists.
- Free parking on the Gibson Mill campus.
